Paris [ a ] is the capital and largest city of France , with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km 2 (40.7 sq mi), and a metropolitan population of 13.2 million as of January 2026 [update] . [ 4 ] Located on the river Seine in the centre of the Île-de-France region, it is the largest metropolitan area and fourth-most populous city in the European Union (EU). Nicknamed the "City of Light", partly because of its role in the Age of Enlightenment , Paris has been one of the world's major centres of finance , diplomacy , commerce , culture , fashion , and gastronomy since the 17th century [ 7 ]
